settings.text:
The polysulfide sealant applicator is an auxiliary machine used in the production of double-glazed glass and windows. It enables faster and more accurate application of polysulfide sealant and is designed to provide precise control over the application quantity, volume, and pressure.
In addition to improving sealant quality, the machine makes the sealing process easier in the factory. Before introducing this applicator, let's take a look at double-glazed glass and the machinery used to produce it.

settings.title: What Are the Characteristics of Double-Glazed Glass?
settings.text:
A double-glazed unit consists of two or more panes of glass arranged parallel to each other at equal spacing and separated by spacer bars.
The space between the panes contains air or a dry insulating gas, such as argon or krypton, at a pressure approximately equal to the outside air pressure.
Aluminum spacers are commonly used in double-glazed units, and their cavities are filled with desiccant.
The desiccant absorbs moisture from the air between the panes, while suitable sealants provide a complete airtight seal.
Using double glazing and insulated doors and windows can save approximately 7 cubic meters of gas per square meter per year.
In addition to reducing energy consumption, this also helps create a cleaner environment. Other characteristics of double-glazed glass include:
1. Reduced energy loss
2. Reduced noise pollution
3. Prevention of glass condensation
4. Greater safety compared with single glazing

settings.title: ماشین آلات تولید شیشه دوجداره
settings.text:
The double-glazed glass production process begins with glass sheets being placed on the automatic handling machine's conveyors and transferred to the automatic cutting table in the quantity specified by the operator.
Optimization software calculates the required glass dimensions to minimize waste, and the machine then cuts the sheets accordingly.
After separation, the glass sheets are transferred to the insulating glass production line. They are first washed thoroughly with softened water, then undergo quality inspection before moving to the next stage.
In parallel, spacer frames are bent and cut to the required glass dimensions. The inside of each frame is then filled with desiccant.
Both edges of the spacer frame are coated with butyl using a butyl applicator. This seals the frame and allows it to be positioned between and bonded to the two panes of glass.
The frames are transferred for installation on the glass, and the assembled units are then moved to the pressing machine.
At the same time, argon gas is automatically injected into the double-glazed unit. The perimeter is then filled with polysulfide sealant to provide the secondary seal.
The following machines are essential throughout this process:
Automatic glass loading, cutting, and breakout machine
Fully automatic glass washing machine
Panel-type double-glazed glass pressing machine
Spacer bar cutting machine
Butyl applicator
Polysulfide sealant applicator
Fully automatic inert gas filling machine

settings.title: What Is a Polysulfide Sealant Applicator?
settings.text:
Polysulfide sealant is widely used as a high-performance sealant in double-glazed glass manufacturing, the aerospace industry, tank sealing, and other applications.
Its resistance to chemicals makes it a durable and reliable sealing material.
Double-glazed glass units are insulated to provide the performance expected of a suitable, standard window.
There are several ways to apply polysulfide sealant. In modern double-glazed glass production, automated application technology has replaced labor-intensive manual methods.
The polysulfide sealant applicator is designed so that the amount and volume of discharged sealant can be adjusted according to material flow and pressure, reducing material waste.
This machine is specifically designed to process a wide range of high-viscosity materials.
Accordingly, the machines are configured to dispense, meter, and mix resins under optimum conditions.
Two-component polysulfide sealant, which offers improved properties compared with conventional polysulfide sealant, can be used in double-glazed glass production, providing users with confidence in the quality and durability of the finished product.
Two-component polysulfide sealant is suitable for sealing joints and bonding components and structures. It is used in industries such as petrochemicals, refineries, and manufacturing plants, as well as for sealing precast concrete and many other applications.
It is also a suitable option for sealing double-glazed windows. In addition to its strength and durability, it remains flexible under movement and prevents water and moisture from entering the cavity between the panes.
This helps ensure the quality and reliability of double-glazed windows.
Key properties of polysulfide sealant include:
Flexible, with high elasticity
Resistant to cracking
Resistant to sunlight and UV radiation
Resistant to abrasion, corrosion, and impact
Resistant to corrosive chemicals such as salts and petroleum products
Environmentally compatible
Specified working time
Solvent-free
Provides high-strength bonding

settings.title: Technical Specifications of the Polysulfide Sealant Applicator
settings.text:
As explained above, using a polysulfide sealant applicator can improve sealant quality and make the sealing process on a double-glazed glass production line easier.
With the following features and capabilities, this machine addresses the problems that may arise from manual mixing and helps ensure sealant quality without air contamination.
Its technical specifications include:
Two-component drums, compatible with 360 kg drums
Fully pneumatic operation; no electrical power required
Original, high-performance pneumatic equipment and powerful cylinders
High-quality, standard components
Electrostatic powder coating with oven curing
Three-star Gold Warranty for 18 months
After-sales service and spare parts supply for 360 months
